command:
python3 /app/merge_users.py && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import pyarrow as pa
import pyarrow.parquet as pq

parquet_path = Path('/app/merged_users.parquet')
conflicts_path = Path('/app/conflicts.json')

table = pq.read_table(parquet_path)
df = table.to_pandas()
with conflicts_path.open() as f:
    report = json.load(f)

expected_columns = ['user_id', 'name', 'email', 'created_date', 'status']
assert table.schema.names == expected_columns, table.schema.names
assert pa.types.is_integer(table.schema.field('user_id').type), table.schema.field('user_id').type
assert pa.types.is_string(table.schema.field('name').type), table.schema.field('name').type
assert pa.types.is_string(table.schema.field('email').type), table.schema.field('email').type
assert pa.types.is_string(table.schema.field('created_date').type), table.schema.field('created_date').type
assert pa.types.is_string(table.schema.field('status').type), table.schema.field('status').type
assert set(df['user_id']) == {101, 102, 103, 104}, set(df['user_id'])
assert df['user_id'].is_unique
for value in df['created_date'].dropna():
    assert re.fullmatch(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', str(value)), value
assert isinstance(report.get('total_conflicts'), int)
assert isinstance(report.get('conflicts'), list)
assert report['total_conflicts'] == len(report['conflicts'])

print('\n== parquet schema ==')
print(table.schema)
print('\n== merged rows ==')
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print('\n== dtypes ==')
print(df.dtypes)
print('\n== conflict report ==')
print(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
print('\nValidation passed.')
